hero.title: Every moment with your pet, in one home.
hero.subtitle: Track health and vaccines, find the nearest vet, adopt a new best friend, reunite lost pets with their families, and share it all on PawHub. Petaverse brings it together.

features.title: One app for every side of pet parenthood
features.subtitle: Petaverse brings health tracking, community, adoption and lost & found together, so you're never juggling five different apps for one pet.

items.title: PawCare health tracking
items.description: Health score, nutrition, activity and vaccination status at a glance, plus reminders before the next vet visit.

items.title: PawHub community
items.description: A feed just for pet people: follow other pets, share posts, comment, and discover who's nearby.

items.title: Adoption
items.description: Browse listings from shelters and fosters near you, filter by species and breed, and apply right from the app.

items.title: Lost & Found
items.description: Report a missing pet in seconds, alert nearby volunteers, and get matched with found-pet sightings on the map.

items.title: Nearby providers map
items.description: Find vets, groomers and pet shops around you, with ratings, hours and directions built in.

items.title: PawBot assistant
items.description: Ask about nutrition, breed-specific care or symptoms and get grounded, practical answers instantly.

showcase.title: Designed to feel like home
showcase.subtitle: A warm, uncluttered interface built so every pet parent, not just the tech-savvy ones, feels at ease.

pawcare.title: Health tracking that keeps you ahead of it
pawcare.description: See your pet's health score, nutrition status and activity in one screen, keep vaccination records up to date, and never miss the next vet visit again.

community.title: A social feed built for pets, not ads
community.description: Give your pet a profile, follow the ones you meet at the park, and share their moments with a community that actually cares.
bullets: Follow, comment and discover nearby pets
Co-own a profile with family or a partner
Lost & found alerts woven right into the feed

howItWorks.title: Up and running in three steps

steps.title: Create your pet's profile
steps.description: Add your pet's species, breed and basics, or bring over records from your vet.

steps.title: Set up PawCare
steps.description: Log vaccinations, track nutrition and activity, and find providers near you.

steps.title: Join PawHub
steps.description: Follow other pets, post updates, and tap into the lost & found network in your area.

footer.description: Petaverse is the one home for every moment with your pet: health, community, adoption and lost & found, together.
